title: ISM Services PMI / NMI spot-check values
description: Headline Services PMI (formerly NMI) values read by hand out of the prose of ISM's monthly Services Report on Business releases, then compared by scripts/reconcile-ism.ts against the merged Services series this site publishes. Tolerance is 0.5 because ISM reports to one decimal. These exist for months a single source carries — 68 of 79 for Services, since PRNewswire coverage only begins in 2025. Where both the Wayback archive and the curated series hold a month, reconcile-ism.ts cross-checks them automatically and no manual entry is needed. Seed at acquisition-path boundaries: a scraper regression corrupts values per URL era, so one anchor per era catches it. Parallel to data/ism-spot-checks.json for Manufacturing.

entries.note: First month of the series. Legacy ism.ws/NonMfgROB.cfm era — a single rotating page where the snapshot timestamp, not the URL, determines the month, so a mis-dated capture would silently attribute the wrong value. Prose: "The NMI registered 58.6 percent in September".
Last month before the structural 2015-04 to 2020-05 archive gap. Legacy ism.ws era. Prose: "The NMI registered 56.5 percent in March".
First month after the structural gap, and the first on the ismworld.org per-month URL scheme. Prose: "The NMI registered 57.1 percent".

Last single-source month, and the last on the /ism-report-on-business/ path. ISM renamed the segment to /ism-pmi-reports/ immediately after, which silently stalled the scraper here until 2026-08. Everything from 2025-08 on is cross-checked against PRNewswire automatically. Prose: "In July, the Services PMI registered 50.1 percent".
